title: Animation with Encaustic Painting
content: Bulgarian artist Theodore Ushev has developed an encaustic painting technique for his animated film "The Physics of Sorrow."In an interview forCartoon Brew, he says: "The first ever time capsules were the Egyptians tombs. And they had these beautiful, realistic portraits on the cover of their sarcophagus, created with encaustic painting. Made of melted beeswax and color pigments, they stayed absolutely intact for 20 centuries. So I thought this would be the perfect technique to employ for my film. But I had to not only learn to paint an image or a portrait using this technique, but also invent a way to make it move."----The Physics of Sorrow: The Technique (Making-of)fromNFB/marketingonVimeo.Via:Cartoon BrewWikipedia on Encaustic painting
